title: `nvs meta --json <entry>` names a user class's parent and interfaces fully qualified, and `nvs doc` prints them
scope:
the program half of `nvs meta --json <entry>` and the page `nvs doc` renders from it. The
registry half is unchanged, and so is the no-argument form.
dependsOnText:
[0137](0137.md) (`nvs meta --json` takes a program, and `nvs doc` renders that
document and nothing else).

summary.headline: `nvs doc` names a class's parent class and interfaces
summary.body:
`nvs meta --json app.nvs` now gives each class an `extends` key with its parent class and an
`implements` key with its interfaces. Each name is written in full, with its namespace. `nvs doc`
prints both at the top of the class page, and writes `static` in front of a static method.
